capex_inputs.label: Recommendation
capex_inputs.value: APPROVE WITH A DEMAND CHECKPOINT - meets the criteria in Base and Upside, fails in Downside

capex_inputs.label: Decision rule
capex_inputs.value: Rule: reject if Base fails; approve outright only if Downside also passes; otherwise approve with a checkpoint. Downside NPV -$15.9m: with Power demand growth of 2% a year, demand never exceeds existing capacity, so only yield, scrap and savings benefits remain.

capex_inputs.label: Checkpoint
capex_inputs.value: Checkpoint: release the purchase order once trailing Power demand exceeds 71.48m good units a month (95% of current good-unit capacity at max utilization).
